hints.title: Ancestor Context
hints.text: In a valid preorder traversal, each non-root node must have its parent present on the active ancestor path.

hints.title: Subtree Stack Tracking
hints.text: Maintain active ancestors in a stack, popping elements whose subtrees have completed.

hints.title: Parent Matching
hints.text: Pop from the stack until the top element equals the current parent; if the stack empties, the traversal is invalid.

hints.title: Ancestor Stack Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Each node ID is pushed and popped from the stack at most once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Building and searching ancestry via tree search takes quadratic time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models preorder ancestry validation via monotonic-style stack popping.
